title: A manual record (runRecord) leaves no trace the send-now duplicate check can read, so a second send-now for the same meeting launches a second bot
evidence: runRecord (capture/record-commands.ts:71-205) writes only .record-state.json via writeControllerState (record-commands.ts:148): fields pid, sessionId, title, platform, until, obsOutputDir, startedAt - no meeting URL, one slot per record dir. It never touches data/webinar-release/operations.json, raw/webinars/schedule-state.json or raw/webinars/scheduled/*.json, which are the only stores readLiveJobs reads.
reproduction: 1) node cli.js send-now https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij --until 15:00 (launches runRecord, bot joins). 2) One minute later run the same command again. readLiveJobs returns [] (no scheduled job file, no operations row), planSendNow returns ok, a second runRecord launches a second bot into the same meeting. Unit-level proof: send-now-command.test.ts 'readLiveJobs' shows state sources are only operations.json + scheduled/*.json.
fix_direction: Own checked unit: have send-now (or runRecord) write a durable live-job record carrying the normalised meeting URL before launching, and clear/finish it on exit; or have the duplicate check also read .record-state.json once that file carries the meeting URL. Needs writes to state, not done here (schedule-state.ts and record-commands.ts off limits for this unit).

title: Poller-launched recordings are also not URL-matchable: operations.json rows carry status but no meeting URL, and the poller writes no scheduled/<jobKey>.json
evidence: scripts/webinar/run-pipeline.mjs:216-219 sets operations[id] = {status:'queued'/'recording', title, startTime, endTime, attempts} then runs `record <url>`; no url field is stored (auto-record-policy.ts keeps meetingUrl only inside registration proofs). Scheduled job files (url, until, sessionId) are written only by the task-scheduler path (calendar/schedule-tick.ts:263). So readLiveJobs can match a URL only for task-scheduler jobs.
reproduction: While the poller has a webinar in 'recording' state (operations.json row status recording, no raw/webinars/scheduled file), run send-now with that webinar's join URL: readLiveJobs yields no job with that URL, plan is ok, a second bot is launched.
fix_direction: Store the normalised meeting URL (or meetingKey) on the operation row at queue time, in a checked unit that edits the poller/schedule-state; then readLiveJobs maps it directly.
